# What the neo-tax plugin sends

The neo-tax plugin reports metadata about AI coding sessions so Neo.Tax can attribute AI token spend to the pull requests and tickets it already tracks. This page lists every field it can send. The list is generated from the allowlist inside the agent; any field not listed here is removed on the engineer's machine before it is written to disk or sent.

## Identity

Neo.Tax receives one value meant to identify the engineer: the email the engineer confirms at enrollment, which is stored with the device's key rather than sent with each event. Events carry the device id, and Neo.Tax knows which engineer enrolled the device.

Three other values are not meant to identify anyone but can. `branch` is free text the engineer or their tools choose, so it can contain a name, a username, or anything else typed into it. `repo.owner` is the account that owns the repository, which is a personal username when the repository lives under a personal account rather than an organization. The device hostname, sent once at enrollment as a readable name for the device, often contains the engineer's name.

## Never sent

Prompt text, completion text, tool inputs, tool outputs, file paths, the working-directory path, and session titles never leave the machine.

## Fields by event kind

### `session.closed`

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |
| `device_id` | Random id minted for this device at enrollment. |
| `harness` | Which coding harness ran the session, for example claude-code. |
| `harness_version` | Version of the harness, as recorded in its transcript. |
| `agent_version` | Version of the neo-tax-agent binary. |
| `session_id` | The harness's own random id for the session. |
| `event_kind` | Which kind of session event this is. |
| `sent_at` | When the agent created the event. |
| `ended_at` | When the session ended. |
| `reason` | Why the harness ended the session, for example logout or exit. |
| `dropped_events` | How many events the agent discarded because its local queue was full. |
| `side_usage` | Token counts, one entry per model, of the session's model calls that produced no turn of their own (the session title, the recap after time away, compaction's summary); null when the harness recorded no session totals. |
| `side_usage[].model` | Model name the calls ran on. |
| `side_usage[].input` | Uncached input tokens. |
| `side_usage[].output` | Output tokens. |
| `side_usage[].cache_write_5m` | Input tokens written to the five-minute prompt cache. |
| `side_usage[].cache_write_1h` | Input tokens written to the one-hour prompt cache. |
| `side_usage[].cache_read` | Input tokens read from the prompt cache. |

### `session.opened`

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |

| `repo.host` | Git host, for example github.com. |
| `repo.owner` | Organization or user that owns the repository. |
| `repo.name` | Repository name. |
| `branch` | Current git branch name; null on a detached HEAD or outside git. |
| `head_sha` | Commit hash HEAD pointed at. |
| `dropped_events` | How many events the agent discarded because its local queue was full. |

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the event conforms to. |
| `device_id` | Random id minted for this device at enrollment. |
| `harness` | Which coding harness ran the session, for example claude-code. |

| `usage.speed` | Speed the request ran at, standard or fast, which sets its price per token. |
| `usage.source` | Where the counts came from: payload, transcript, or unknown. |

## At enrollment

Enrollment sends one request, when the engineer runs `neo-tax:login`. That happens once per device, and again only if the device has to enroll again, for example after its device key is rejected. This request is separate from session events; its email and hostname are never sent with a session event. The list is generated from the enrollment request in the wire contract.

| Field | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | Version of the wire contract the request conforms to. |
| `enrollment_token` | The enrollment token the engineer's Neo.Tax admin issued; it can only enroll devices. |
| `email` | The email the engineer confirms at login, stored with the device key. |
| `email_confirmed_by` | Who confirmed the email: engineer when the engineer typed or chose it at login. |
| `device` | The machine and harness being enrolled. |
| `device.hostname` | The machine's hostname as the operating system reports it at enrollment, recorded as a readable name for the device id so engineers can tell their devices apart. It often contains the engineer's name. It is not updated if the hostname changes later; enrolling again sends the current hostname under a new device id. |
| `device.os` | Operating system, for example darwin or linux. |
| `device.arch` | CPU architecture, for example arm64 or amd64. |
| `device.harness` | Which coding harness the device is enrolled for, for example claude-code. |
| `device.harness_version` | Version of the harness; null when unknown. |
| `device.agent_version` | Version of the neo-tax-agent binary. |
